# Confidence Calibrator Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Use when calibrating AI confidence scores, detecting overconfident or underconfident outputs, adjusting certainty levels based on evidence quality, or flagging low-confidence claims.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [confidence-calibrator-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
confidence-calibrator-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@confidence-calibrator` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze technical systems and identify areas for improvement
- Execute automated workflows with validation checkpoints
- Apply technology-specific best practices and industry standards
- Generate structured technical outputs with quality metrics

## Industry Standards Applied

- **IEEE 730**: Software quality assurance processes and standards
- **ISO 25010**: Software quality model: functional suitability, reliability, maintainability
